_doc: Every keymap slot / DKS action / MT key / macro-key etc. is a 3-byte action {type, code1, code2}. Tables extracted from page-f17bd796bc939422.js (pretty lines 828-1530: C,S,D,A,E,Z,B,R; picker categories `e1` ~16717; picker keyboards full_keyboard(_JIS).json modules 82109/73569). Name decoding is function T() (~1322), code computation N() (~1369).

0.name: none / transparent? (UNVERIFIED; empty slot written as 0,0,0)

16.name: keyboard
16.code1: HID modifier bitmask: 0x01 LCtrl,0x02 LShift,0x04 LAlt,0x08 LGui,0x10 RCtrl,0x20 RShift,0x40 RAlt,0x80 RGui
16.code2: HID keyboard usage (page 0x07). A bare modifier key is {16, mask, 0}. Combos (modifier+key) are {16, mask, usage}.

112.name: macro
112.code2: macro mode/repeat (copied from macro item; UNVERIFIED semantics)

150.name: TD (tap dance; only offered for types 120-122)

255.name: read-back value treated as empty in getKeyInfos (code -1)

fnLayerKeys: {240,255,n}: FN key; picker offers n = 4*profileIndex + 0..3 (profile 0: FN..FN3, profile 1: FN4..FN7, ...). Labels FN, FN1..FN15. {240,254,0} = FN_M.

special.note: filtered per profile: FN keys only those with code2 in [4p,4p+3]; 'E/J' only for type 112

macroEncoding.note: In macros a key is stored as a raw HID usage byte; modifiers (224..231) are stored as bitmask 1<<(usage&15) with kind=1. See PROTOCOL.md macros.
